color_rules.생성_문장: PROP COLOR: calm pastel or muted tones that suit the Zaoseon character style, or the object's own natural color (wood = soft natural wood, fruit and vegetables = their real colors). Never neon, never harsh pure primary colors, never dull muddy gray. Props keep strong contrast with the dark background board. PROP COLOR MIX (K-292): never paint every prop in one slot. Each prop gets the slot of its own natural material, and a prop with several parts (cup body / lid / sleeve, desk top / legs, laptop body / keyboard, badge card / strap) uses 2–3 different slots by part. When a picture has several props, they use different slots — do not make them all blue (or all one color). PROP OUTLINE (deep tone-on-tone): outline each prop with a DEEP, CLEARLY DARKER shade from the SAME color family as its own fill — blue/sky props → deep navy, mint/green → deep teal or forest green, warm beige/wood/yellow → deep brown, pink/coral → deep rose or plum. Never black (#000000), never just a slightly darker mid-tone of the fill, never the character's own outline color. EFFECT LINES (shout, surprise, speed lines): the character's outline color (#FFFFFF on dark boards). FACE-ATTACHED MARKS (anger vein, sweat drops, tears): flat solid color shapes with NO outline, like the blush on the cheeks.
